text: I am enveloped by the precision of glass and steel just outside a modern meeting room. It is quiet—almost reverent—a space for ideas, yet presently devoid of energy. As I move into the burst of color and concept in the next scene, I am invigorated. Here, the intellectual pulse is palpable. The wall's text and design speak to innovation and curiosity, nudging me to contemplate not just what is known, but what might be discovered. I feel part anticipation, part awe—a visitor at the threshold of creativity.
